title: Hedging Scheduled Political Events: replication code, inputs and results
description: Code, event inputs and results for the paper Hedging Scheduled Political Events: Cheap Convexity for Long-Only Emerging-Market Investors (Santiago Negrotto, SSRN Working Paper, 2026). The decision protocol in code/framework.py (SHA-256 prefix 221320a15437) was frozen on 11 November 2026 and is archived here unchanged, together with the pre-registered run of 11 November 2026 and the final run of 13 November 2026 reported in the paper. Purchased option data (iVolatility) and third-party price data (B3, Stooq, FRED) are not included; the repository lists the exact files and ticker-days and provides a download script for the public sources.
